name: Tempered Bowbelly
description: Plant the lead foot and pull the blade through the target in a cut that never loses balance.

name: Torrent Inwardbelly
description: Brace the haft along the forearm and slip a blow off the wood toward the outside.

name: Thorngarner
description: Snatch at a trailing sleeve or strap with the hook and tether the target to your arm.

name: Glancing Glean
description: Skim across the ground in a brisk low step that closes the gap before the opponent resets.

name: Chime Stook
description: Spiral the hook around the enemy's hilt and wrench it free with qi in the forearm.

name: Gustgarner
description: Rise from a crouch with the edge leading, cutting up through the guard and across the chest.

name: Granite Sicklegrip
description: Lock qi through the arms and haft so the wood holds like iron against a heavy overhead blow.

name: Sheave Torment
description: Pin the plate edge on the hook and rip the tip through the exposed lining underneath.

name: Reapedge Plating
description: Roll the curve over an incoming blade, turning it away and carrying the edge on into the attacker's neck line.

name: Harpooning Reap
description: Extend the arm fully and cut at the farthest reach of the blade along the field's outer edge.

name: Garnerhauberk
description: Lift the hook under the enemy's wrist and check the rising strike before it gains speed.

name: Enduring Crookspine
description: Cross the haft over the blade before the chest and take the stroke on both wood and steel.

name: Reapsprint
description: Move heel-first and silent between obstacles, with the qi field smoothing every footfall.

name: Iron Greenedge
description: Catch the opponent's guard on the tip and poke through the opening it makes.

name: Might Harvest
description: Feed qi into a wide sweeping draw that keeps cutting as the arm travels across the front.

name: Mayhem Sickletang
description: Hook a cloak or banner and tear it down across the opponent's eyes and weapon arm.

name: Garner Sprint
description: Slip across the line of two attackers as one crosses a furrow, leaving them facing each other.

name: Lancing Handleknob
description: Gather field qi into the blade and loose one broad sweep that cuts every enemy standing before you.

name: Suppressing Hookblade
description: Anchor the hook on the opponent's belt, twist hard and throw them across your hip into the ground.

name: Tempered Crookspine
description: Probe along the armor's edge with the tip until it slips into a gap and bites.

name: Implacable Inwardbelly
description: Scrape the curve across the plate of an incoming gauntlet and carry the blow wide.

name: Might Tipcurve
description: Let the curve bite into a surface and pull steadily until the edge opens it.

name: Garnercloak
description: Hook a shoulder strap or sword belt and tug to drag the wearer off their stance.

name: Rumblegarner
description: Force the hooked tip into an elbow or knee seam and pry until the joint locks.

name: Blaze Hookblade
description: Lift the shoulder plate with the hook and slice the unprotected join beneath it.

name: Glint Handleknob
description: Seat the tip under a breastplate buckle and draw so it bursts and the armor falls open.

name: Harrowing Tipcurve
description: Slide the reversed blade along the gorget rim, hook the chin plate and cut where it parts.

name: Toxin Reapedge
description: Hook the weapon hand mid-swing and check its arc before it reaches you.

name: Gust Greenedge
description: Strike the incoming blade with the edge so it rings and rebounds from your line.

name: Subduing Garner
description: Catch a loose sleeve on the hook for the half-breath it takes to cut beneath.

name: Rumble Stook
description: Flip the blade into a reverse grip and slice along the inside of the opponent's forearm.

name: Sicklegrip Hauberk
description: Lift the hook-and-haft angle against a shield rim and hold it up to open the line.

name: Gust Reap
description: Shuffle behind the hooked weapon and let the caught arm shield your own approach.

name: Gleangreave
description: Trap the enemy's sword between the hook and haft and twist until the grip loosens.

name: Chimestraw
description: Wrap the hook around a spear shaft and pull the spearman off balance.

name: Rumble Sheave
description: Snap a burst of qi through the hooked weapon to jar open the enemy's fingers.

name: Gleanhauberk
description: Lock the hook on the enemy's weapon, hurl it clear and cut the hand left empty.

name: Staggering Bowbelly
description: Hook across both forearms and draw them apart with qi to strip every weapon from the grip.

name: Skinning Glean
description: Cross both sickles at the throat and draw them apart in a single scissoring cut.

name: Hoarfrost Sicklegrip
description: Close both blades in an X before the body and catch a heavy cut in the crossing.

name: Reapplating
description: Feed the left hook beneath the enemy's guard to pin their arm while the right blade waits.

name: Might Sickletang
description: Step so the feet mirror the blades, left foot moving as the left hand cuts.

name: Glint Reap
description: Dart the right tip through the gap the left blade has made in the guard.

name: Grassbarrage
description: Bring both curves in from the sides and close them like shears on the opponent's neck.

name: Crippling Harvest
description: Hook one arm from above and one from below and heave them into a locked bar.

name: Chime Greenedge
description: Sweep the blades in opposed arcs to catch a spear thrust between them and push it wide.

name: Rumble Handleknob
description: Walk forward with both blades crossing in steady alternation, harvesting every limb that enters the cut.

name: Sheavecloak
description: Spiral both hooks around a weapon in opposite turns, tear it away and cut as it falls.

name: Tempered Stook
description: Drop from a raised stance into a downward slice, the curve leading like a diving talon.

name: Chime Bowbelly
description: Lift the blade skyward and let a descending blow slide off the curve and away.

name: Thorn Harvest
description: Snatch at the opponent's shoulder or pack with a swift talon-like hook and clutch.

name: Bounding Crookspine
description: Sidestep with arms spread wide like wings, letting the attack pass beneath the extended blade.

name: Sanguine Hookblade
description: Cut upward on a rising step and return the blade to guard in one circular motion.

name: Rumble Glean
description: Flick the wrist as if shaking off dew and snap the hooked tip across the enemy's eyes.

name: Drubbing Sheave
description: Rake the curve down the outer arm in the manner of a talon stripping a wing.

name: Reapcloak
description: Stoop beneath a strike, set the hook behind the knee and drop the opponent flat.

name: Gust Reapedge
description: Rise onto the toes with the blade angled up and carry a sweeping cut over your head.

name: Thornreap
description: Seize the opponent's weapon arm with hook and free hand and hold it with steady qi.

name: Reapbarrage
description: Plunge the curve from above and rip downward through shield, mail and flesh in one drop.

name: Tipcurve Cloak
description: Hook the target with the field's qi, haul them forward and meet them with a rising cut.

name: Gustgrass
description: Pull the blade across in the slow swell of a basin tide, power gathering through the cut.

name: Murk Inwardbelly
description: Let the hook follow a blow around the bend and slip it out beyond your shoulder.

name: Hookblade Hauberk
description: Step with measured court pace behind the blade so the guard travels with each stride.

name: Soaring Sickletang
description: Retreat in two matched paces, the second pulling the blade back to cover the first.

name: Fastening Tipcurve
description: Loop the hook around the opponent's wrist and draw it into the arc of the swing.

name: Blaze Glean
description: Run the blade low across the ground in a flowing sweep that carries on with the current of qi.

name: Reaptorment
description: Pivot on the rear foot as in a crowded courtyard and cut the nearest enemy in the turn.

name: Mayhemreap
description: Gather qi like a rising flood and loose a sweeping hook that cuts across every foe on the plain.

name: Fastening Sheave
description: Draw the opponent along a current of qi on the hook, then cut as they arrive.

name: Blaze Sicklegrip
description: Pull the edge with the wind at your back, adding its push to the draw of the cut.

name: Thorn Greenedge
description: Plant the feet like a plateau rim and take the blow on the blade held broad against the wind.

name: Suppressing Harvest
description: Time the hook to a gust so the opponent's cloak catches and pulls them forward.

name: Siltgrass
description: Take a bearing and step off a ledge or rim line, landing already turned toward the foe.

name: Irongrass
description: Slice across a crosswind so its push bends the cut onto the target's far side.

name: Thorn Sickletang
description: Hold the hook fast on the opponent's arm with steady qi, as an oath is held, and draw it in.

name: Murk Handleknob
description: Catch a cut on the blade and lift it upward as an updraft lifts a hawk.

name: Grinding Garner
description: Sweep low in a wide arc across open ground where nothing blocks the long reach of the blade.

name: Inwardbelly Onslaught
description: Swear the hook to the wind's pull and tear the opponent's guard open as it surges.

name: Immovable Bowbelly
description: Meet the attack like a plateau gust, turn it aside and draw the edge across the opening.

name: Sanguine Garner
description: Fix a bearing on the target and pull the blade through along that single line.

name: Mightgarner
description: Walk the narrow rim of a cliff or ditch with the blade out to hold balance against the wind.

name: Mayhem Greenedge
description: Angle the hook into the gust so it flips the opponent's guard open for your cut.

name: Facet Bowbelly
description: Hold the guard still and steady as a sworn word, however the wind and the enemy push.

name: Silencing Crookspine
description: Step to the windward side and hook the opponent's lead arm to stop it dead.

name: Sanguine Inwardbelly
description: Slip to the leeward side where the wind covers your steps and cut the exposed flank.

name: Stifling Tipcurve
description: Hook the foe at a drop and fall together so the rim receives them first, leaving the blade free.

name: Chimegrass
description: Hold the bearing through the opponent's strike, turn it with the curve and cut back along the same line.

name: Tempered Reap
description: Slice into the face of a rising squall so the wind pushes the blade against the target.

name: Thorn Reapedge
description: Catch a wrist on the hook and hold fast as a sworn word holds against the wind.

name: Ironstraw
description: Turn so the body sits in the lee of the blade and take the blow on its broad flat.

name: Reapedge Pounce
description: Skip across level plain in long light bounds that the wind carries a little farther.

name: Sanguine Stook
description: Chop down on the crest of a gust and let its push add weight to the stroke.

name: Garnergreave
description: Flick the blade so a small breath of air whips grit and chaff across the enemy's eyes.

name: Might Handleknob
description: Drag the edge through the target while a steady squall of qi leans on the back of the blade.

name: Mayhem Harvest
description: Snap the hook the moment the wind shifts to wrench the opponent's guard around with it.

name: Murk Sicklegrip
description: Hold a sworn line with the blade and send each strike sliding off along its curve.

name: Splintering Stook Barrage
description: Ride the squall's push into a hook that rips through the guard and drags the opponent forward.

name: Sickletang Greave
description: Sweep the hook along the wind to rip the weapon free and cut across the open hand.
